limitations: 16 MiB random DAG exceeds the current node cap; only raw/zstd and raw-CAS smoke checks are planned
Application cache state is controlled; OS page/disk caches are not flushed
Repeat full-copy controls have empty target scopes; warm raw-CAS and DAG share the general object-cache shortcut
Localized edits change 32 bytes; scattered edits change 1024 bytes, not an equal edit budget
Receiver CPU covers decode/handle/encode; relay/cloudflared CPU and socket wait are excluded
HTTP body counts are not packet/link bytes; failed-upload counts are attempted body bytes
Transfer timing starts with generated in-memory inputs before graph/codec preparation; fixture generation is measured separately
Arms use seeded counterbalanced paired order, not an independent random shuffle
Begin cache hits are valid only for repeat raw-CAS/DAG targets; any hit during a seed, cold upload, or modified-target upload invalidates that operation
